stem: Triangle \( PQR \) is dilated with the center of dilation at the origin to form triangle \( P'Q'R' \).

options.label: A
options.text: Triangle \( PQR \) was dilated by a scale factor of \( \frac{1}{3} \) to create triangle \( P'Q'R' \).

options.label: D
options.text: Triangle \( PQR \) is congruent to triangle \( P'Q'R' \).

visual_elements: graph with two triangles PQR and P'Q'R' on coordinate grid with points P(1,3), Q(4,1), R(1,1) and P'(3,9), Q'(12,3), R'(3,3)
